name: Greyhorn Cavern
description: A two-floor cave in the south-western hills, good for a few chests and a great deal of practice.

g1_entry.name: The Greyhorn Mouth
g1_entry.description: A wide slanting opening in the hillside, with the daylight behind you.

g1_a.name: The Weeping Passage
g1_a.description: A passage where water runs down the walls and drips from the roof.

g1_chest.name: A Side Chamber
g1_chest.description: A dry little chamber off the passage, with a chest against its far wall.

g1_stair.name: The Stair Down
g1_stair.description: A stair of broken steps leads down into a deeper dark.

g2_landing.name: The Lower Landing
g2_landing.description: A rough landing, with four ways leading off it.

g2_a.name: The Long Gallery
g2_a.description: A long gallery of dripping flowstone.

g2_torch.name: The Dry Alcove
g2_torch.description: A dry alcove with a chest.

g2_band.name: The Narrow Room
g2_band.description: A narrow room with a chest and a smell of old smoke.

g2_gold.name: The Low Chamber
g2_gold.description: A low chamber, with a chest tucked under the roof.

g2_trove.name: The Hidden Hollow
g2_trove.description: A last, hidden hollow at the end of a crawl-way. A heavy chest sits in the middle of it.
